name: Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet
description: Disables Energy Efficient Ethernet to reduce latency spikes and keep network connection behavior more consistent.

description_i18n.en: Disables Energy Efficient Ethernet to reduce latency spikes and keep network connection behavior more consistent.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Energieeffizientes Ethernet, um Latenzspitzen zu reduzieren und das Netzwerkverhalten stabiler zu halten.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'Ethernet Économe en Énergie pour réduire les pics de latence et maintenir un comportement réseau plus cohérent.

warnings.title: Network behavior changes
warnings.message: Disabling this feature may alter how your network card manages power states, potentially affecting background traffic patterns on some hardware

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the Energy Efficient Ethernet property on network adapters by setting its display value to On or Off This change is applied without restarting the adapter
